Name: VO_Brick_Script_Line_01
Subtitle: Howdy, little lady.
Delivery: Slow, smoldering matinee drawl; tips hat

Name: VO_Brick_Script_Line_02
Subtitle: This town ain't big enough for my jawline.
Delivery: Dead serious, chin raised, to camera

Name: VO_Brick_Script_Line_03
Subtitle: Kiss me, Clementine... in the key light.
Delivery: Breathy romantic hero, small pause before 'in the key light'

Name: VO_Brick_Script_Line_04
Subtitle: Stand back. I do my own stunts.

Name: VO_Brick_Script_Line_05
Subtitle: A man's gotta do... what his agent says.
Delivery: Grand monologue voice, long pause, then flat

Name: VO_Brick_Script_Line_06
Subtitle: Ride with me into the sunset. Camera left.
Delivery: Sweeping and heroic, then a quick practical aside

Name: VO_Brick_Hurt_Light_03
Subtitle: Unhand me, furniture!
Delivery: Indignant hero shouting at a chair

Name: VO_Brick_Hurt_Light_04
Subtitle: I meant to do that.
Delivery: Quick recovery, trying to sound cool

Name: VO_Brick_Hurt_Heavy_03
Subtitle: Tell my fans... I was magnificent.

Name: VO_Brick_Blame_03
Subtitle: That was NOT in the script!

Name: VO_Brick_Wet_01
Subtitle: I'm drenched... ruggedly.
Delivery: Shivering but trying to stay manly

Name: VO_Brick_Mood_hungover_01
Subtitle: Why is the key light so LOUD?

Name: VO_Vivienne_Script_Line_01
Subtitle: Oh, Brick... you've come back.
Delivery: Mid-Atlantic grande dame, swooning, hand to heart

Name: VO_Vivienne_Script_Line_02
Subtitle: Kiss me as if the studio were watching.

Name: VO_Vivienne_Script_Line_03
Subtitle: Careful, cowboy. That stunt is MY scene.

Name: VO_Vivienne_Script_Line_04
Subtitle: I have waited forty years for this monologue.

Name: VO_Vivienne_Script_Line_05
Subtitle: The sunset is mine, cowboy. You may follow.

Name: VO_Vivienne_Notice_04
Subtitle: Is NO ONE watching the set?!

Name: VO_Vivienne_Hurt_Light_04
Subtitle: I've been ASSAULTED by a prop!

Name: VO_Vivienne_Hurt_Heavy_02
Subtitle: Fetch my lawyer... and a pillow.

Name: VO_Vivienne_Hurt_Heavy_04
Subtitle: Tell the press... I suffered beautifully.

Name: VO_Vivienne_Panic_03
Subtitle: Not the gown! NOT THE GOWN!

Name: VO_Vivienne_Blame_03
Subtitle: Who let the intern near my mark?

Name: VO_Vivienne_Blame_04
Subtitle: I was promised a SAFE set!

Name: VO_Vivienne_StormOff_01
Subtitle: I'm going to my trailer!
Delivery: Exit line, projected to the back row

Name: VO_Vivienne_StormOff_02
Subtitle: Call me when you've hired professionals!

Name: VO_Vivienne_StormOff_03
Subtitle: I've worked with chimps who were more careful!

Name: VO_Vivienne_StormOff_04
Subtitle: Find yourselves a new leading lady!

Name: VO_Vivienne_Mood_furious_at_Brick_03
Subtitle: Brick. You're in my light. AGAIN.

Name: VO_Gus_Script_Line_01
Subtitle: Quiet on set! Please? Thanks!
Delivery: Fast, high, nervous; voice cracks on 'Please'

Name: VO_Gus_Notice_03
Subtitle: Oh no oh no oh no.

Name: VO_Gus_Hurt_Heavy_02
Subtitle: Tell my mom... I was on a real set...

Name: VO_Gus_Hurt_Heavy_03
Subtitle: I can see... the craft services table...

Name: VO_Gus_Panic_03
Subtitle: I didn't touch it! I didn't touch it!

Name: VO_Gus_Panic_04
Subtitle: Where's the exit?! Where's the EXIT?!

Name: VO_Gus_FixIt_01
Subtitle: I got it! I got it!

Name: VO_Gus_Faint_01
Subtitle: I'm gonna... lie down... right here...

Name: VO_Gus_Blame_01
Subtitle: Was it me? It was me, wasn't it.

Name: VO_Gus_Wet_01
Subtitle: Is this water? Please say water.

Name: VO_Gus_Mood_over_caffeinated_01
Subtitle: I'm fine I'm fine I'm FINE!

Name: VO_Gus_Mood_over_caffeinated_03
Subtitle: Can I help? Can I help? Can I help?

Name: VO_Director_Action_01
Subtitle: ACTION!
Delivery: Through a megaphone, big and commanding
